notes.title: Gameplay Improvements: V1.1.0
notes.content:
I've heard the feedback.

[list]
[*] The computer puzzle has been reworked to make it much easier to understand and solve. Now [u]you will only need to change the quantity of each color[/u], whereas previously you also had to change the colors themselves.
[*] You can also [u]see how much red, green and blue are in the final color[/u].
[*] In addition, [u]the TESTER window now shows how much of Red, Green and Blue you need[/u] to make the 3 desired colors (brown, pink and yellow).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731135/f4ce4dcc446d62055b604a2b8eb3f92f47d1beca.jpg[/img]


[u]I'm really sorry for those who had trouble solving it and felt frustrated. [/u]

V1.1.0 also fixes small issues and reduces the overall difficulty of the game.


If you have any feedback don't hesitate to let me know.

Thank you!

notes.title: Some development news!
notes.content:
[h1]First of all, thank you so much for all the support on social media and steam![/h1]
We hit more than 4M views on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@glaseeze]TikTok[/url], 600K on [url=https://www.instagram.com/glaseeze/]Instagram[/url] and have reached the 7K wishlists mark on steam!


[h1]Now some updates about development. [/h1]
The OG Cake Factory is becoming way bigger than originally planned. Due to the strong increase in content, development is taking more time and the game's playtime is increasing as well.

The game was originally intended to be Free-to-play with a paid DLC, but given the new direction it is taking, it will most likely be [u]paid without any additional DLC[/u]. Despite that, there will be a [u]free demo available at least for the Steam Next Fest of October[/u]!

Nothing is certain yet, the game might be Free-to-play anyway, but it is what you can expect for the release of the game that will be in [u]late 2024 or early 2025[/u]!


Apologies for the inconveniences :/

-Glaseeze
